How the average works +

We add up the current scores of all 15 real teams and divide by 15. The empty league-average team (#12) is excluded. Projected final uses the same calculation with ESPN’s live projections, which already include points scored.

Including the team playing against the average changes the number, but doesn’t change whether that team finishes above or below it before rounding. Missing projections are shown as unavailable, never as zero. ESPN’s projections can change during games and are not guaranteed outcomes.

Pregame projected league average: —. Past matchup cards use the Average’s posted score; this comparison uses the recalculated all-team mean. Scores use your league’s scoring rules. This version supports single-week matchups.
